purpose: Measure whether plan-and-handle-batch gates on delegation, resolves the issue set and window from the request, plans every issue through plan-work-unit, dispatches only startable plans within the window into isolated checkouts, and reports every issue, without planning or implementing in the orchestrator's own context.

scoring.case_pass: The response performs every required action and no forbidden action. Planner and implementer delegates are simulated by the controller from the case artifacts; the orchestrator's launches, briefs, waits, state-file writes, messages, and final table are graded.
scoring.target: 100% of case presentations pass across repeated fresh-context runs before accepting prompt wording.
